summary: ledgerly personal-finance tool built from scratch: CSV import, categorisation rules, budgets and monthly summaries, versioned JSON storage, and a CLI

parts.title: CSV import: parser, date and amount formats, row validation, duplicate detection
Categorisation rules: validation, ordered first-match rules
Budgets and monthly summaries: integer cents, yearly split, carry-over, rounding
Storage: versioned JSON ledger, v1 to v2 migration, idempotent import, atomic save
Command line: import, categorize, report, budget with exact output and exit codes
